subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive + capacity kickoff
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@clearstream.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@clearstream.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive + capacity kickoff

Hi Laura / Samir —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive and capacity kickoff: 

Recap of requirements from today
- Primary workflow: conversational summarization + policy rerank (~60–120 tokens generated per request)
- Peak throughput target: ~160–200 requests/sec (burst to 350rps for short windows)
- Latency target: P95 gen latency <= 300ms for 64-token responses; tail latency is the main customer SLO
- Data controls: VPC private deployment preferred; audit-log retention 1 year

What we propose for the next meeting (technical deep-dive + pool planning)
- Goals: align on model family, steady-state throughput, test profiles, and a runbook for controlled ramping into a Dedicated GPU pool
- Deliverables before the call: a short load-profile CSV + peak/daily traffic windows (we can adapt your format)
- Duration: 60–75 minutes (we'll bring a Solutions Eng and an Ops engineer)

Suggested slots (PT):
- Wed 2027-08-25 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu 2027-08-26 13:00–14:15 PT
- Fri 2027-08-27 09:00–10:15 PT

I've attached a short precall template (precall_load_template.xlsx) to make the load numbers quick to fill in. If you want, Ben (Solutions Eng) can draft a preliminary pool topology based on a filled template.

If these times don't work, send a few windows and we'll accommodate. Also let us know any existing performance tests or telemetry you can share ahead of time (prometheus snapshots, sample request logs, token distributions).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

Attachment: precall_load_template.xlsx (spreadsheet with columns: endpoint, avg_rps, peak_rps, avg_tokens, peak_tokens, percent_live_traffic)

From: Laura Kim <laura.kim@clearstream.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@clearstream.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive + capacity kickoff

Thanks Mateo — this is helpful and aligns with our notes. A couple quick clarifications before we confirm a slot: 

- The expected steady-state is closer to 150 rps with 300 rps short bursts (so your numbers are fine).
- For latency: our internal goal is P95 <= 250ms, but we'll accept up to 300ms during initial ramp if the plan has clear rollback steps.

We can do Thu 2027-08-26 13:00 PT (Samir and I are available). Please include your Solutions Eng and whoever will own the load simulation.

We're attaching a short traffic snapshot from Q2 to give you an idea of token distribution and peak windows. Also, two asks for the pre-call:
1) Could you send a short list of the telemetry fields that are most helpful (token counts, latency histograms, nvml GPU metrics, request/response samples)?
2) Do you have a rough template for model variants and quantization tradeoffs so we can preview options?

Laura
Director of Engineering | Clearstream Finance
laura.kim@clearstream.com | +1 646-555-0199

Attachment: clearstream_traffic_snapshot_Q2.csv (sample: hourly_rps, avg_tokens, peak_tokens, region)

Laura confirmed Thu 2027-08-26 13:00 PT for the technical deep-dive + capacity kickoff. Can Ben own the run-of-show and the load simulation plan? Priyom, please prepare the precall checklist and a short note on recommended model variants (quantized vs. fp16) based on the attached snapshot.

Primary asks for the call:
- Ben: bring a proposed Dedicated pool topology for 150–300rps, and a short testing plan (steps + expected metrics).
- Priyom: 1-page variant recommendation (cost vs perf tradeoffs) and a list of telemetry fields we want them to surface ahead of time.

I'll also pull the sample request logs into a private drive folder and share the link. Ben — can you also draft a short failover plan (model fallback + throttling) we can review?

Thanks — I’ll send the official invite in ~10 mins.

Sounds good — I’ll take point on the runbook and load sim. Quick summary of what I’ll prepare before Thu: 
- Draft runbook: topology options (2xA100-style pool for steady-state, 1x high-burst pool), ramp schedule, rollback triggers (error rate, P99 latency)
- Load simulation plan: traffic shaping script, token distribution to mirror Q2 snapshot, target metrics (P50/P95/P99 latency, GPU util, memory pressure)
- Failover options: lower-precision model variant + autoscale thresholds

I’ve attached a short draft of the runbook to get feedback. I’ll iterate once Priyom drops the variant note.
